record.context_brief: Measurable perfect matchings in Schreier graphs
record.original_question: Let Act(F_∞,([0,1], λ)) be the space of measure-preserving actions of the free group F_∞ on the Lebesgue probability space, and for x in this space let Sch(x) be the Schreier graph of the action. Is the set of actions whose Schreier graph admits a measurable perfect matching Σ^1_1-complete?

evidence.quote: Problem 42. Is the set {x ∈ Act(F∞,([0, 1], λ)) : Sch(x) has a measurable perfect matching} Σ1_1-complete?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $F_\infty$ denote the free group on countably infinitely many generators, with a fixed free generating set $S = \{s_1, s_2, \dots\}$. Let $([0,1], \lambda)$ denote the unit interval with Lebesgue measure, and let $\mathrm{Act}(F_\infty, ([0,1], \lambda))$ denote the Polish space of measure-preserving actions of $F_\infty$ on $([0,1], \lambda)$ (with the usual weak topology inherited from the Polish group of measure-preserving transformations).

For an action $x \in \mathrm{Act}(F_\infty, ([0,1], \lambda))$, define the Schreier graph $\mathrm{Sch}(x)$ to be the (labeled) graph on vertex set $[0,1]$ whose edges are the pairs $\{t, s_i \cdot_x t\}$ with $t \in [0,1]$ and $s_i \in S$. A measurable perfect matching of $\mathrm{Sch}(x)$ is a Borel (equivalently, $\lambda$-measurable) set $M$ of edges of $\mathrm{Sch}(x)$ such that, modulo a $\lambda$-null set, every vertex $t \in [0,1]$ is incident to exactly one edge in $M$.

Consider the set
$$A = \{x \in \mathrm{Act}(F_\infty, ([0,1], \lambda)) : \mathrm{Sch}(x) \text{ admits a measurable perfect matching}\}.$$

Determine whether $A$ is $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^1_1$-complete (i.e., analytic and complete for the class of analytic subsets of Polish spaces under Borel reducibility).
artifact.category_tag: descriptive set theory and measurable combinatorics
artifact.status_search_result: No source was found resolving the $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^1_1$-completeness of the set of measure-preserving $F_\infty$-actions whose Schreier graph admits a measurable perfect matching. Recent related work establishes Baire-measurable perfect matchings in Schreier graphs of free actions of non-amenable groups, but does not address the descriptive complexity classification asked here. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Baire Measurable Matchings in Non-Amenable Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Every Schreier graph of a free Borel action of a finitely generated non-amenable group has a Baire measurable perfect matching.
status_evidence.claim: Recent related work concerns existence of Baire-measurable matchings in Schreier graphs, but does not address Sigma^1_1-completeness.
